basis: The dashboard shows a full-period cooling water temperature change from 23.9°C in 2005 to 10.1°C in 2014, a decrease of 13.8°C. The independent visual notes explicitly characterize this as a 'substantial decrease over the period.' Although no numeric threshold is printed on the chart, the visible evidence supports the change being substantial in magnitude, mapping directly to the routing criterion for substantial-change follow-up.
option_label: Route the 2005 to 2014 cooling water temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
